subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 3: Vocabulary and Grammar (days of the week)
outcomes: I can say the days of the week in order.
I can ask and answer Does he / she … on …?
I can spell the days of the week.

tf.s: The weekend in Oman is Friday and Saturday.
tf.why: Right! Friday and Saturday are the weekend.

tf.s: The week starts with Sunday in our list.
Thursday comes between Friday and Saturday.
tf.why: Friday comes between Thursday and Saturday.
Well done! We don't hear the d in Wednesday.

tf.s: We answer Does she roller-skate on Mondays? with No, she don't.
Days of the week start with a capital letter.
tf.why: Yes! Monday, Tuesday … all start with a capital.

tf.s: We ask: Do he play tennis on Sundays?
tf.why: With he we ask Does he play tennis on Sundays?

tf.s: There are five days in a week.
tf.why: There are seven days in a week.

boxes.q: What day is between Thursday and Saturday?

boxes.why: Friday and Saturday are the weekend.

boxes.q: Answer: Does he go to school on Thursdays? (yes)
Answer: Does she roller-skate on Mondays? (no)
Ask about Sara and basketball on Mondays:
o: Does Sara play basketball on Mondays?
Do Sara play basketball on Mondays?

mcq.q: Which list is in the correct order?
Which days are the weekend in Oman?
mcq.why: The weekend is Friday and Saturday.

mcq.q: How do we start the question about he?
A boy rides a bike on Tuesday. Does he ride a bike on Tuesdays?
mcq.why: The picture shows him riding on Tuesday.

mcq.q: A girl skateboards on Wednesday. Does she roller-skate on Wednesdays?
A girl listens to music on Thursday. Choose the question and answer.
o: Does she listen to music on Thursdays? Yes, she does.
Do she listen to music on Thursdays? Yes, she do.
Does she listens to music on Thursdays? Yes, she does.
Does she listen to music on Thursdays? No, she doesn't.
mcq.why: Does she + verb …? Yes, she does.

mcq.q: Today is Thursday. What day is it tomorrow?
Your timetable card is empty on Tuesday. What do you ask your partner?
o: What does Sara do on Tuesdays?
mcq.why: Ask to find the missing information.

mcq.q: Ahmed goes to school on Sundays. Does he go to school on Fridays?
o: No, he doesn't. Friday is the weekend.
Yes, he does. Friday is a school day.
mcq.why: Friday is the weekend in Oman.
